title: MinIO object storage (paraphrase)
text: MinIO is an object store that implements the Amazon S3 API and can run locally as a single binary or container. The community edition is licensed under the GNU AGPLv3. MinIO documents which S3 features are supported; some AWS-specific features are not implemented.
